StringTable.String: The Ilythiir are an amphibious, highly intelligent humanoid species distinguished by light-blue scaled skin, majestic sweeping horns, and delicate finned ears reminiscent of their deep-ocean origins. Possessing a graceful, enduring physiology, they effortlessly bridge the gap between abyssal aquatic depths and terrestrial living.
